subject: English
question_text: Write the summary of the passage in no more than 80 to
guide_solution: Summary The passage is about the causes and remedies of price hike. Price hike is a common problem in our country. Due to price hike people, specially the fixed income group suffer a lot. Some causes of price hike are that the dishonest business men creat artificial crisis of daily commodities. Political instability, shortage of supply and price hike of international markets. By taking action against the dishonest businessmen, establishing political stability and by importing necessary commodities, government can control price hike.  অনুবাদ(Passage No. 2) : 136 See Jhenidah Govt. High School. Sl. No. 78; Page No. 126
